description: This file contains a set of shell script functions related to managing and upgrading boot partitions, UUIDs, and boot media for iMX-based Linux systems within the OpenWrt project.

methods.name: rootpartuuid
methods.description: Retrieves the root partition UUID from the kernel command line.

methods.name: bootdev_from_uuid
methods.description: Finds the device name associated with the root UUID.

methods.name: bootpart_from_uuid
methods.description: Gets the boot partition device associated with the root UUID.

methods.name: rootpart_from_uuid
methods.description: Gets the root partition device associated with the root UUID.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_mount_boot
methods.description: Mounts the boot partition at /boot if not already mounted.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration file to the boot partition.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs system upgrade by extracting kernel and root files from a given image.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Prepares the system for upgrade, resetting filesystems if needed.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_move_config
methods.description: Moves the backup configuration file from /boot to the root filesystem.
